records.cueHe: איתיביה רבי יוחנן לרבי שמעון בן לקיש
records.about: the baraita about a ben pekua that crossed a river and then entered a cemetery

records.cueHe: בשלמא לדידי דאמינא תרי גופי נינהו ... אלא לדידך
records.about: on Reish Lakish's one-body view the fetus was already made susceptible by its mother's blood, so the river is superfluous
the baraita speaks of a dry slaughter that emitted no blood

records.cueHe: ורבי שמעון בן לקיש אמר: חלבו כחלב חיה
records.about: whether the fat of a non-viable newborn is forbidden like that of a domesticated animal
Reish Lakish's reason is that completion of the months of gestation is what makes a fetus an independent animal

records.cueHe: רבי שמעון בן לקיש אמר: חלבו כחלב חיה, חדשים ואוירא גרמי
records.about: whether completed gestation alone, or gestation together with emergence into the air, makes a fetus's fat forbidden

records.cueHe: איתיביה רבי יוחנן לרבי שמעון בן לקיש
records.about: the baraita excluding a fetus's fat from the fats that must be burned on the altar

records.cueHe: בשלמא לדידי, היינו דאיצטריך קרא למעוטי, אלא לדידך, אמאי איצטריך?
records.about: if the fetus's fat were not forbidden, no verse would be needed to exclude it from the altar

records.cueHe: אמר ליה: טעמא דידי נמי מהכא
records.about: that same exclusion is itself the source for holding the fetus's fat permitted

records.cueHe: איתיביה רבי שמעון בן לקיש לרבי יוחנן
records.about: the same guilt-offering baraita, now deployed against R' Yohanan

records.cueHe: מה חלב ושתי כליות האמורות באשם מוצא מכלל שליל
records.about: the taught exclusion of a fetus's fat from the offerings

records.cueHe: בשלמא לדידי, משום הכי מיעטיה רחמנא, אלא לדידך – ליקרב?
records.about: if the fetus's fat really is forbidden fat, it ought to be offered on the altar rather than excluded

records.cueHe: אמר ליה: מידי דהוה אמחוסר זמן
records.about: the fat is forbidden yet unfit for the altar, just as an animal whose time has not yet arrived is

records.cueHe: רבי שמעון בן לקיש, ואיסורא דאורייתא
records.about: Reish Lakish's opposing view, that sinews destined to harden are not counted as flesh

records.cueHe: הלכתא כוותיה דרבי שמעון בן לקיש בהני תלת

records.cueHe: אל תקניטני, בלשון יחיד אני שונה אותה
records.about: asking Reish Lakish not to provoke him with questions, since he teaches the ruling only as a lone opinion

records.cueHe: רבי שמעון בן לקיש, ואיסורא דאורייתא

the mishna's liability for slaughtering the second animal applies only where the first was slaughtered for idolatry and the second for his table

records.cueHe: אמר ליה רבי יוחנן: זו, אפילו תינוקות של בית רבן יודעין אותה!
records.about: that Reish Lakish's limitation states only the obvious rule that a greater penalty absorbs a lesser one, so it cannot be the mishna's point

records.cueHe: וריש לקיש אומר: פטור, דכיון דכי אתרו ביה פטור
records.about: the rationale of Reish Lakish's exemption — since forewarning would have exempted him, its absence does not create liability
why Reish Lakish's exemption had to be stated for the idolatry case and could not be inferred from the monetary case

records.cueHe: אבל בהא – אימא מודי ליה לרבי יוחנן
records.about: on the hypothetical that only the idolatry case had been taught, Reish Lakish would have conceded liability for the monetary penalty

records.cueHe: אבל בהא אימא מודי לרבי שמעון בן לקיש
records.about: on the hypothetical that only the monetary case had been taught, R' Yoḥanan would have conceded exemption from lashes in the idolatry case

records.cueHe: ואמר רבי שמעון בן לקיש: אומר היה רבי שמעון
records.about: Reish Lakish attributes to R' Shimon the view that the red heifer can still be redeemed even upon its pyre

records.cueHe: אמר רבי שמעון בן לקיש משום רבי ינאי
records.about: Reish Lakish reports in R' Yannai's name that the broken-necked heifer clause is not part of the mishna

records.cueHe: ורבי שמעון בן לקיש אמר: כיון דכי אתרו ביה – פטור
records.about: whether a transgression carrying death for which no forewarning was given still cancels the lashes incurred for the lighter prohibition

records.cueHe: אנן משמיה דרבי שמעון בן לקיש מתנינן לה
records.about: Rav Pineḥas teaches the ruling in Reish Lakish's own name rather than as a quotation from R' Yannai

records.cueHe: כי הוינן בי רב פפי קשיא לן, מי אמר רבי שמעון בן לקיש הכי?
records.about: Reish Lakish cannot have called the clause spurious, since his own verbal analogy makes the heifer forbidden from the time it is taken and so its slaughter unfit
the stated dispute over when the leper's birds become forbidden, in which Reish Lakish dates the prohibition from their being taken

records.cueHe: רבי יוחנן אמר: משעת שחיטה, ורבי שמעון בן לקיש אמר: משעת לקיחה
records.about: from when the leper's birds become forbidden for benefit — from the moment of slaughter or from the moment they are taken

records.cueHe: ואמרינן: מאי טעמא דרבי שמעון בן לקיש?
records.about: the grounds on which Reish Lakish dates the birds' prohibition from the moment they are taken
a verbal analogy on 'taking' carries the heifer's prohibition-from-designation over to the leper's birds
the heifer verse supplying the second limb of the verbal analogy on 'taking'
